I recently stopped at the Tesla Supercharger in Liège, Belgium, and overall it was a very solid and convenient charging experience. A charger became available quickly, and I was able to plug in without any delay, which is always a big plus during a road trip.

The charging speed was very good, and my car gained range efficiently, allowing me to continue my journey without wasting time. Even with the station being quite crowded, everything was well organized and smooth.

Another major advantage of this location is the nearby Quick restaurant. Being able to walk over and enjoy a meal at Quick while the car is charging makes the stop much more enjoyable. Instead of sitting in the car, you can have a proper break, eat comfortably, and relax before getting back on the road. This is especially helpful on long-distance drives when you really appreciate a chance to rest and recharge yourself as well.

Overall, the Liège Tesla Supercharger offers fast and reliable charging, handles heavy usage well, and benefits greatly from its convenient food options nearby. Even though it can be busy, the fact that I didn’t have to wait and could enjoy a meal nearby makes this a highly recommended stop for anyone traveling through Belgium.

Tesla Supercharger in this location is functional and serves its primary purpose of charging your vehicle, but it is important to note that there are very few amenities or alternative options nearby. Unlike other charging stations that might be located near shopping centers, restaurants, or rest areas, this one is isolated. If you find yourself in urgent need of a charge, it certainly works, but for anyone planning a stop, there is little else to do while your car is charging.

There are no convenient cafes, restaurants, or shops within walking distance, and restroom facilities are minimal or absent. This makes it less ideal for longer stops or for travelers who prefer to combine charging with other activities. Because of this, I would generally only recommend using this station if you really need a charge and there are no better options nearby. It is a practical backup rather than a place to plan a deliberate stop.

Its location is somewhat accessible from the main road, so reaching it is straightforward, but the lack of amenities and alternatives makes it a station that I wouldn’t choose unless necessary. For Tesla drivers who have other charging options, it’s worth prioritizing stations with more nearby services. Overall, this Supercharger gets the job done, but don’t expect a comfortable or convenient stop unless you are in a tight spot.
